blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY, LEYTE, Philippines — Nine of 11 major irrigation systems monitored by the National Irrigation Administration (NIA) in Eastern Visayas have recorded below-normal water levels, prompting the agency to adjust water delivery schedules to farmers.
